title: Regional Sales Manager
location: Hamburg, Germany (field-based, travel across Northern Germany)
description: Halvorsen supplies industrial fasteners, tooling, and maintenance products to manufacturers across Northern Germany. We're looking for a Regional Sales Manager to own a territory of existing accounts, grow new business with mid-sized manufacturers, and hit quarterly revenue targets. You'll spend most of the week visiting customer sites, negotiating contracts, and working closely with our inside sales and logistics teams.
requirements: 5+ years of B2B field sales experience, ideally in industrial or manufacturing supply
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue quotas
Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills with purchasing managers
Experience managing a sales pipeline in a CRM such as Salesforce
Valid EU driving licence and willingness to travel up to 4 days a week
nice_to_have: Technical background in mechanical engineering or maintenance
Existing network of manufacturing customers in Northern Germany
